findings.problem: The trick says welcher ends in ch, but it ends in -er; only its stem welch- ends in ch.
findings.fix: trick: WELCHER is an old cousin of English which: drop the -er ending and welch- looks a lot like which.

back.example: Which bus goes to the station?

note: The prompt works because der Bus is masculine and the subject, so the answer is exactly welcher; other prompts would need welche or welches.
